label: Fresh at cutoff
method: Synthetic inputs: 1,000 expected rows, comprising 850 fresh, 100 late and 50 missing. Moving 60 late rows before the cutoff gives 910/1,000 = 91%, compared with 85%, a six-percentage-point increase. This is not a forecast-accuracy claim.
